verdict.rationale: GrowthBook has a public pricing page with tiers: a Free plan (no credit card, up to 3 users, 1 project, unlimited flags, experiments and traffic) and higher tiers listing their added features. This tells a PM that seats and projects drive cost while traffic and MAUs do not. However, the evidence shows no actual dollar amounts or per-seat rates for paid tiers. Missing for 10: published price figures for paid plans, explicit per-seat or usage pricing formula, independent corroboration of how pricing scales.
